follow-up time: 1 year for mothers diagnosed with postpartum depression
finding: While there was no difference in PPD prevalence between COVID-19 infected and non-infected mothers, peripartum anxiety was higher in non-infected mothers, and medical comorbidities, history of psychiatric illness, domestic violence, and obstetric complications were significant risk factors for PPD.
followup_time: Postpartum, with 1-year follow-up for those diagnosed with PPD
